# AI Heroes

> AI Heroes B.V. (Groningen, the Netherlands, KvK 42051968) builds AI tools your team uses every day, for organisations that want more than a pilot. Three ways in: a new AI tool, replacing old software that no longer fits, or self-hosted AI (on your own servers or with a European provider). The first step is always the start sprint: six days, fixed price, from EUR 8,000 (the same for all three ways in), it can start within two weeks of the first call and ends in a working prototype or a build plan, always with the business case on one page. Builds start from EUR 15,000; after delivery AI Heroes keeps maintaining and developing the system. Office: Aarhusweg 4-16, 9723 JJ Groningen. Contact: info@aiheroes.io, +31 50 200 3373.

AI Heroes bouwt AI-toepassingen die je team elke dag gebruikt, voor organisaties die verder willen dan een pilot. Drie ingangen: een nieuwe AI-toepassing, oude software vervangen of lokale AI. De eerste stap is altijd de startsprint: zes dagen, vaste prijs, vanaf EUR 8.000, start binnen twee weken. Van ambitie tot implementatie. Vanuit Groningen, voor heel Europa.

## The AI Heroes standard (included in every build)

- Business case first: cost, return and payback on one page, before we build
- Compliance from the drawing board: AI Act classification, logging, human oversight, European hosting
- Your people can work with it: the team that will use the system is trained on that system (Article 4 of the EU AI Act)
- Not tied to one AI vendor: built model-agnostic, everything documented

- [The start sprint](https://aiheroes.io/en/start-sprint): six days, fixed price, from EUR 8,000, working prototype or build plan plus business case
- [What we build](https://aiheroes.io/en/what-we-build): the three ways in and everything we build
- [A new AI tool](https://aiheroes.io/en/new-ai-tool): AI customer service, agents and workflows, administration, company wiki, digital twin, integrations, extra developers, custom software
- [Replace old software](https://aiheroes.io/en/replace-software): overpriced SaaS, Excel and legacy systems replaced next to the old system, moved over in phases
- [Self-hosted AI](https://aiheroes.io/en/self-hosted): AI on your own servers or in the European cloud, with the AI Act in the design
- [How we work](https://aiheroes.io/en/how-we-work): from start sprint to maintenance
- [Cost and return up front](https://aiheroes.io/en/business-case) and [What does AI implementation cost?](https://aiheroes.io/en/ai-implementation-costs)
- [Compliance and security](https://aiheroes.io/en/compliance): AI Act check, ISO 42001 guidance, security reviews
- [AI training for your team](https://aiheroes.io/en/training): part of every build; standalone training from EUR 2,500 per half day
